text:
maria: Heads-up: noticed quota dashboard numbers spike for some orgs after TS SDK 0.9.2 rollout. console shows 2-3x usage vs billing. Anyone else?

sanjay: Seen it. Looks like sampling flags not wired to telemetry header on route hint fallback — ingest is still reading the old header.

devon: Is this the same as the sampling fallback issue we chased in July? can't remember details.

joanna: I can repro: create a canary with route affinity + header opt-out -> console shows full sample, but backend actually sampled. Dashboard aggregation side isn't respecting sample-rate.

akeem: Probably an SDK change: we switched to "use-efficient-sampling" default in py/ts. PR #4487 changed header name from X-Route-Sample to X-Rdw-Sample. console ingestion still expecting old header.

pete: Infra can patch ingestion to check both headers for a few days. But we need SDK rollback plan or patch.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out conf patch to staging ingest-service at sha=abc123

maria: Can we do feature flag toggle? I'd rather not rollback SDK for safety-critical users.

sanjay: Agree. Plan: patch ingestion to accept both headers, add transformation to metrics pipeline, add backfill job to recompute aggregates for last 48h, and flag telemetry for affected orgs.

joanna: I'll open a console ticket to surface "sampling mismatch" on org pages and show sampling header present/missing.

devon: SDK owners: can we push a tiny hotfix that keeps old header in addition to new one? Non-breaking.

akeem: Yes. Hotfix in TS SDK in flight: will add header dup for 0.9.3-beta. Also will add runtime opt-in env var REDWOOD_ALLOW_LEGACY_HEADER=true

pete: I'll monitor ingest metrics. If we see >10% reduction in mismatch we cutover.

maria: :thumbsup: Can someone assign follow-ups and PR links?

joanna: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/512, https://github.com/redwood-inference/ts-sdk/pull/1214. I'll add to the console ticket. tagging @sanjay @akeem @pete for postmortem.

devon: Postmortem owner? I'll take it.

infra-bot: infra-bot: alert created INC-2026-213 - quota-dashboard-sampling-mismatch

sanjay: :eyes: let's keep updates to this thread. Will update when backfill completes.
